settings.label: Focus length
settings.help: Twenty-five minutes is the pomodoro. Turn the knob through a focus to change that one only; the next focus starts from here again.

settings.label: Short break
settings.help: The five-minute short break between focuses. A minute is still a break; half an hour is a different job.

settings.label: Long break
settings.help: The fifteen-minute long break that closes a cycle, and the last stop of a press-and-turn.

settings.label: Focuses per long break
settings.help: How many focuses before the long break: four is the classic pomodoro. One makes a focus and a long break, and back again.

settings.label: Start next on its own
settings.help: When a phase ends, Pomodoro waits for a press before the next one. On its own starts the next phase by itself, and chimes at every change either way.

settings.label: Chime at each change
settings.help: One strike as each phase ends, from the theme's own sounds. Off leaves the ring's flash as the only notice.

settings.label: Chime volume
settings.help: A share of the orb's volume: the chime is never louder than the orb's own volume.

settings.label: Wake the screen
settings.help: Light the screen when a phase ends, even while another app is showing.

settings.label: Ring
settings.help: The OS ring shows the phase draining over any app. Off clears it rather than keeping an invisible one.

settings.label: Ring opacity
settings.help: How solid the ring is over any app: 85 reads across a room without hiding what is under it.

settings.label: Ring direction
settings.help: Which way the arc drains from where it starts. Clockwise is how the OS draws progress everywhere else.

settings.label: Ring starts at
settings.help: Where the arc begins: twelve, three, six or nine o'clock.

settings.label: Ring colour here
settings.help: The ring while Pomodoro is on the glass. From the look gives each phase its own colour, so the state reads from across the room.

settings.label: Ring over other apps
settings.help: The ring over another app: from the look, one colour for every state, or the colour of the app you are looking at.

settings.label: Borrow the press
settings.help: Double-press whatever is on the glass to pause, resume or start the next phase without leaving it; a single press stays with that app, just a moment later while the timer runs. Off keeps every press for the app you are looking at. When it's calling borrows the double press only while a phase has ended and waits for you. Whenever it runs borrows it through a focus or a break too. A press that only woke the screen is never borrowed, and the ring pulses once when one comes here.
